method: seeded procedural periodic spectral synthesis; no generated screen illustration and no source-reference pixels

colorManagement.reason: fixed tracked profile bytes keep rebuilds deterministic

edgeTreatment.periodicSynthesis: All fields are filtered on the FFT integer-frequency lattice, so opposite edges are adjacent samples of one torus.
edgeTreatment.deterministicCut: The row and column cuts with the lowest wrap-neighbor energy are moved to the exported origin.
edgeTreatment.runtimeDownsampling: An exact 2x2 toroidal block mean creates the 512px 1x candidate; the 1024px master is the 2x candidate. RGBA is averaged in premultiplied space then returned to straight alpha.
edgeTreatment.runtimeEncoding: lossless WebP with decoded-pixel equality checks

intendedUse: Reusable shell, drawer, card, token, note, and postcard surfaces after separate human approval and later integration.
